description: A ship or boat by MMSI (9 digits), IMO number (7 digits) or name, from open AIS (Digitraffic, northern Baltic). Answers `record` (name, type, flag, size, call sign, stated destination, last position) and `live` (position, speed, course, navigation status now, when in range), or `matches` for a name.
name: ship_lookup
title: Ship Lookup
